CLAIRE DESMITH
Project Manager
Denver, CO • 831-535-2761 • desmithclaire@gmail.com

PROFILE
Project Manager with five years of delivery experience and an Electrical Engineering background, specializing in bringing structure to newly formed and fast-moving technical teams. Skilled at standing up Agile process where none exists, configuring Jira to match, and translating between engineering teams and the executives who depend on them.

SKILLS
Agile / Scrum Delivery • Jira Configuration, Workflows & Reporting • Sprint Planning & Backlog Management • Risk & Dependency Management • Resource & Capacity Planning • AI-Assisted Delivery
Tools: Jira, Slack, Claude, Google Workspace, Figma, Teams

WORK EXPERIENCE

Project Manager | Viecure | Sept 2025 – Present
• Lead end-to-end delivery of a 29-module platform redesign, directing 25+ engineers across product, clinical, and training teams.
• Hold delivery structure in place when pace outruns process, keeping concurrent workstreams on track under tight timelines.
• Resolve competing priorities and cross-team conflict before they stall delivery, negotiating trade-offs that protect timelines.
• Introduce KPIs and delivery metrics at the program level, shifting the team from reactive firefighting to data-informed planning.
• Use AI tools daily to accelerate planning and documentation, validating output before it reaches the team.
• Set realistic expectations by evaluating capacity, negotiating what moves now versus later, and holding commitments on track.
• Present program status, risks, and trade-off decisions directly to senior leadership, translating strategy into action.

Product Manager | King Tide | July 2023 – April 2025
• Managed end-to-end delivery for 30+ client engagements across Retail, FinTech, and HealthTech, prioritizing scope from data.
• Coordinated design, development, and client teams across 5 concurrent projects in 4 countries, keeping stakeholders aligned.
• Ran defect triage with clients and engineers, negotiating fix-now versus defer calls that held launch dates.
• Directed UX strategy and research, including 170+ user tests and competitor analysis, to sharpen usability before launch.

Project Manager | King Tide | Sept 2021 – July 2023
• Built and configured the Agile workflows, Jira boards, and reporting the delivery teams ran on, improving velocity.
• Managed software development projects end-to-end, keeping teams on track, on budget, and aligned with company needs.
• Pulled status and blockers out of engineering teams and translated them for non-technical stakeholders.
• Owned QA and release testing end-to-end, reducing post-launch issues and improving overall product reliability.

EDUCATION
B.S. Electrical Engineering | California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo | 2016 – 2021

VOLUNTEER
Strategic Communication Committee | Metro Caring | 2024 – 2026
• Improved website usability and accessibility for Denver Metro Caring through user research and QA testing.

Crisis Counselor | Crisis Text Line | 2018 – 2020
• Provided real-time crisis intervention, de-escalation, and active listening to people in acute distress under pressure.
